title: Sodomites
sourceLines: -(The inhabitants of Sodom, many of whom openly practiced homosexuality)
-Destroyed by fire as a judgement Ge 19:24,25
-To be judged according to opportunity Mt 11:24; Lu 10:12
-A proverbial term of reproach applied to those who practiced sodomy (ritual ho- mosexuality) De 23:17; 1Ki 14:24; 15:12; 22:46; 2Ki 23:7; Job 36:14
-The word “harlot” (“shrine prostitute” (N. I. V.)) appears in Ge 38:21,22
-And is the translation of a Hebrew feminine form of the word translated elsewhere “sodomite” Ho 4:14
